doc.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dream projects: Evolution of the Blues on Broadway
summary: He hopes to see the Evolution of the Blues on Broadway and to record the Miles Ahead and Porgy and Bess albums.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I don’t think that was a good last question, so no regrets. I think this is better. What are some of your dream projects that you’d like to accomplish, that you’d like to implement?

I’d like to see Evolution of the Blues where it belongs, on Broadway. That’s where it was headed when we interrupted it and sued the thieves who had stolen it and were producing it. So I would like to see that work, which I think is a divine work and a divinely inspired work, where it belongs, which is on Broadway. That is one dream I would like to see realized. Another one is to see all the ideas that I have, and some of which I’ve put forth, bear fruit. I would like to actually be in a studio, recording the entire Miles Ahead album or the Porgy and Bess album. I’d like to do these things. These are ideas I have. I suppose they’re dreams until they’re real. But they’re more than dreams to me, because I will do them. They will be done.
